organization_name.rationale: Organization name is a form header field not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule C canonical XSD candidate list.

ein.rationale: The filing organization's EIN is a form header field not present as a leaf element in the Schedule C canonical candidates (idx 67 is EIN inside Section527PoliticalOrgGrp, not the filer's EIN).

tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a form header attribute not represented as a leaf element in the Schedule C canonical XSD candidate list.

part1_section_527_exempt.rationale: No candidate corresponds to a checkbox for section 527 exemption status in Part I header; no matching element in the candidate list.

part1_section_501c_exempt.rationale: No candidate corresponds to a checkbox for section 501(c) exemption status in Part I header; no matching element in the candidate list.

part1_exempt_subsection.rationale: No candidate element captures the specific 501(c) subsection number from Part I, line 1.

part1_total_political_expenditures.rationale: PoliticalExpendituresAmt corresponds to total political expenditures reported in Part I, line 2.

part1_volunteer_hours.rationale: VolunteerHoursCnt captures the estimated volunteer hours for political campaign activities in Part I, line 3.

part1a_political_expenditures.rationale: TotalExemptFunctionExpendAmt corresponds to total amounts expended for section 527 exempt function activities in Part I-A, line 1.

part1a_volunteer_hours.rationale: InternalFundsContributedAmt corresponds to funds contributed to other organizations for section 527 exempt function activities in Part I-A, line 2.

part1a_tax_owed.rationale: Section4955OrganizationTaxAmt corresponds to the section 4955 tax owed on political expenditures in Part I-A, line 3.

part1b_501h_election.rationale: No candidate element represents the Form 5768 / 501(h) election checkbox; not present in the candidate list.

part1b_affiliated_group_member.rationale: OrganizationBelongsAffltGrpInd indicates whether the organization is a member of an affiliated group that made the 501(h) election.

part1b_lobbying_nontaxable_amount.rationale: LobbyingNontaxableAmountGrp/FilingOrganizationsTotalAmt matches the filing organization's lobbying nontaxable amount for Part I-B, line 1a (filing org column).

part1b_lobbying_ceiling_amount.rationale: LobbyingCeilingAmt corresponds to the lobbying ceiling amount (150% of nontaxable amount) in Part I-B, line 1b.

part1b_total_lobbying_expenditures.rationale: TotalLobbyingExpendGrp/FilingOrganizationsTotalAmt corresponds to total lobbying expenditures for the filing organization in Part I-B, line 1c.

part1b_grassroots_nontaxable_amount.rationale: GrassrootsNontaxableGrp/FilingOrganizationsTotalAmt matches the grassroots nontaxable amount for the filing organization in Part I-B, line 1d.

part1b_grassroots_ceiling_amount.rationale: GrassrootsCeilingAmt corresponds to the grassroots ceiling amount (150% of grassroots nontaxable) in Part I-B, line 1e.

part1b_grassroots_lobbying_expenditures.rationale: TotalGrassrootsLobbyingGrp/FilingOrganizationsTotalAmt corresponds to total grassroots lobbying expenditures for the filing organization in Part I-B, line 1f.

part1b_aff_lobbying_nontaxable_amount.rationale: LobbyingNontaxableAmountGrp/AffiliatedGroupTotalAmt is the affiliated group column for lobbying nontaxable amount in Part I-B, line 2a.

part1b_aff_lobbying_ceiling_amount.rationale: There is no separate AffiliatedGroup variant of LobbyingCeilingAmt in the candidate list; LobbyingCeilingAmt (idx 39) appears to be a single value, so the affiliated group lobbying ceiling cannot be matched.

part1b_aff_total_lobbying_expenditures.rationale: TotalLobbyingExpendGrp/AffiliatedGroupTotalAmt corresponds to the affiliated group total lobbying expenditures in Part I-B, line 2c.

part1b_aff_grassroots_nontaxable_amount.rationale: GrassrootsNontaxableGrp/AffiliatedGroupTotalAmt corresponds to the affiliated group grassroots nontaxable amount in Part I-B, line 2d.

part1b_aff_grassroots_ceiling_amount.rationale: There is no separate affiliated group variant of GrassrootsCeilingAmt in the candidate list; the ceiling (idx 34) appears to be a single value.

part1b_aff_grassroots_lobbying_expenditu.rationale: TotalGrassrootsLobbyingGrp/AffiliatedGroupTotalAmt corresponds to the affiliated group grassroots lobbying expenditures in Part I-B, line 2f.

part1c_substantial_part_test.rationale: NotDescribedSection501c3Ind most closely corresponds to the Part I-C checkbox indicating the organization did not file Form 5768 and uses the substantial part test.

part1c_direct_lobbying_expenses.rationale: TotalDirectLobbyingGrp/FilingOrganizationsTotalAmt matches total direct lobbying expenses for Part I-C, line 1a (filing org column).

part1c_indirect_lobbying_expenses.rationale: No candidate element for indirect/grassroots lobbying expenses in the Part I-C (substantial part test) context is distinct from the 501(h) grassroots lobbying elements; no clean match.

part1c_total_lobbying_expenses.rationale: TotalLobbyingExpendituresAmt corresponds to the total lobbying expenditures line in Part I-C.

part1c_other_exempt_purpose_expenditures.rationale: OtherExemptPurposeExpendGrp/FilingOrganizationsTotalAmt matches other exempt purpose expenditures for Part I-C, line 1d.

part1c_total_exempt_purpose_expenditures.rationale: TotalExemptPurposeExpendGrp/FilingOrganizationsTotalAmt matches total exempt purpose expenditures for Part I-C, line 1e.

part1c_lobbying_expenditures_pct.rationale: No candidate element represents a percentage or ratio for lobbying expenditures as a proportion of total exempt purpose expenditures.

part2_activities.rationale: Part II activity rows are not represented by any single leaf element in the candidate list; the blueprint bundles a repeating group that would need to be mapped to multiple sub-elements not present as candidates.

part3_notice_to_members.rationale: SubstantiallyAllDuesNondedInd corresponds to the Part III, line 1 notice-to-members indicator regarding dues used for nondeductible lobbying/political activities.

part3_dues_nondeductible_amount.rationale: AggregateReportedDuesNtcAmt corresponds to Part III, line 2 aggregate dues subject to the 6033(e)(1)(A) notice requirement.

part3_nondeductible_lobbying_dues.rationale: DuesAssessmentsAmt corresponds to Part III, line 3 aggregate section 162(e) nondeductible lobbying dues amounts.

part3_tax_imposed.rationale: TaxableAmt corresponds to the tax imposed on the organization under section 6033(e) in Part III, line 4.

part3_dues_allocated_to_lobbying.rationale: NonDeductibleLbbyngPltclCYAmt corresponds to current-year nondeductible lobbying/political amounts allocated from dues in Part III, line 5.

part4_supplemental_information.rationale: SupplementalInformationDetail/ExplanationTxt holds the free-form supplemental explanation text in Part IV.
